Use Case

User Stories

A doctor’s office appointment system

An appointment secretary’s activities

  • A patient has to call the doctors’ office (there are multiple doctors) to make an appointment
  • An appointment secretary answers the call and has to do the following:
    • Log into the appointment system
    • Log into the patient records database, and:
      • Access an existing patient’s record
      • Or create a new patient record
    • Ask the caller if this is an emergency
      • If it is, he/she passes the caller to the nurse practitioner on duty
    • Ask the caller if he/she has a preference for a doctor
      • If the caller has a preference, the appointment secretary has to log in and access the doctor’s availability schedule in a separate system
    • Tell the caller the available times for appointments
    • Schedule an appointment with a doctor
    • Update the patient’s record
    • Log into the daily appointment schedule system (a separate system) and add the appointment to the appropriate doctor on the appropriate day

Your challenge:

  • Create 5 User stories from the perspective of an appointment secretary that would improve the way he/she does these activities
  • Use an appropriate User story format
  • Follow the rules for effective User stories

1. Unified Login System
As an appointment secretary,
I want to log into both the appointment system and the patient records database using a single login,
so that I can save time and reduce the complexity of handling multiple logins.

2. Automatic Emergency Handling
As an appointment secretary,
I want to quickly identify emergency calls and automatically transfer them to the nurse practitioner,
so that I can prioritize emergencies without delay.

3. Integrated Doctor Availability
As an appointment secretary,
I want to access the doctor’s availability schedule within the appointment system,
so that I can quickly provide available times to callers without switching to another system.

4. Automated Patient Record Update
As an appointment secretary,
I want to have the patient’s record automatically updated when an appointment is scheduled,
so that I do not need to manually update the records, reducing the chance of errors.

5. Streamlined Appointment Scheduling Integration
As an appointment secretary,
I want to be able to add the scheduled appointment directly to the doctor’s daily calendar within the appointment system,
so that I do not have to manually log into a separate system to update the doctor’s schedule.

Simple course registration

Course registration system

Students login to the Course registration system (CRS) using their student ID and access the course catalog after the Registrar posts it and opens registration.

Students choose and register for each course. A student’s transcript (course history) is checked to verify that they have taken the appropriate prerequisites. They occasionally re-access the CRS and make changes to their schedules.

Academic departmental staff login to the system to examine the courses offered by their department and make changes like closing or canceling a section or a course.

The Registrar closes registration on a pre-determined date and the Registration billing system accesses the CRS and calculates a bill for each student and mails it to a student’s current address.

Professors login to the CRS and access the courses they are assigned to teach and obtain a course roster.

During the semester, Professors access the CRS to advise students and post mid-term grades for student athletes and other special classes of students and for all students at the end of the semester.

At the end of the semester, students fill out course evaluations and the results are posted to the CRS.

At the end of a semester, Professors post grades to the CRS.

Meituan Take-out

Develop a Use case diagram for Meituan Take-out (just ordering food to be delivered to your home)
In addition to the normal stuff you do on Meituan Take-out, the following assumptions apply:

  • Meituan’s system connects to the online ordering system at each restaurant that you see
  • Assume payments to Meituan are processed by PaymentProcessor; which does things like verify the credit card, collect the payment data, and pay the restaurant and the delivery service
  • Meituan’s system connects to Deliverers to arrange for and expedite deliveries

Use includes and extends in your diagram as needed to explicate how Meituan works.

Activity Diagram

ATM activity diagram

Ordering food using Meituan

FIRST: Develop a UML Activity diagram for Ordering food using Meituan
THEN: Write the Normal Flow of Events for the Use Case this Activity Diagram depicts.
The following description and assumptions apply:

  • As a hungry person, you install and open Meituan
  • You are either a new user who needs to set up a profile or a returning user
    • As a returning user, you may want to make changes to your profile
  • You access menus through the app
    • You may find something that looks good and place an order and checkout
  • If you do place an order, you use the app to check the status of your order

Create an Activity diagram and add a short Use case description

  • For the Use case description, add a Note box below your Activity diagram and list the normal flow of events to order food.
  1. 用户验证：美团（Meituan）首先验证用户身份。
    • 若为新用户（New user? 分支为 Yes），需创建用户资料（Create profile）。
    • 若为老用户（New user? 分支为 No），可选择是否更新资料（Update profile?），若选择更新（Yes），则执行更新资料操作（Update profile）；若不更新（No），进入下一步。
  2. 进入菜单与点餐：用户进入菜单（Access menus）后，选择是否点餐（Order food?）。若不点餐（No），流程结束（以 “×” 表示）；若点餐（Yes），进行下单（Place order）操作。
  3. 结账与资料处理：用户结账（Checkout）时，美团会调取用户资料用于结账（Access user profile）。若没有可用于结账的用户资料（User profile for checkout? 分支为 No），美团会收集新的结账信息（Collect new checkout info）；若有（Yes），进入下一步。
  4. 订单处理：美团处理订单（Process order），包括验证支付信息、向餐厅发送订单、向用户反馈等环节，最终完成整个点餐流程。

Use case discription

Use case name: Order food
Primary Actor: Hungry person (User)
Stakeholders:

  1. User - wants to order food
  2. Meituan - wants to process order & collect payments

Brief description: The use case describes how a hungry person uses the app to create or change their profile and order food
Trigger: User logs in to Meituan
Association relationship: Hunger person

Normal flow of events:

  1. The hungry person opens or logs in to the app
  2. If the hungry person is a new user: Execute the Create profile subflow
  3. If the hungry person is a returning user who wants to change his/her profile: Execute the Update profile subflow
  4. The hungry person accesses the menus: If the user places an order, execute the checkout & associated process:
    • The app accesses the user profile
    • The app asks the user if he/she wants to use the profile info
    • If the user wants to change his/her checkout info: Execute the Collect new checkout info subflow
    • The app processes the order

User profile includes:

  1. Preferences
  2. Preferred payment & delivery location info

Process order includes:

  1. Valid payment info
  2. Send order to restaurant
  3. Send feedback to hungry person

关系类型 图示特征 含义说明
Association —— 表示两个类之间存在某种静态关系，是类与类之间最基本的关联
Generalization ——▷ 即继承关系，子类（派生类）继承父类（基类）的属性和方法，体现 “is - a” 关系
Aggregation ——◇ 表示 “整体 - 部分” 关系，部分可独立于整体存在，是一种较弱的包含关系
Composition ——◆ 表示 “整体 - 部分” 关系，部分的生命周期完全依赖于整体，是一种较强的包含关系
